description: A slate-blue wool apron dress with restrained red-and-ochre geometric woven borders at the straps, neckline and hem, fastened with two modest round metal shoulder brooches, over a cream linen shift with sleeves ending below the elbows and a modestly open neckline. A multicolored woven belt has long tasselled ends; the layered long skirt leaves brown soft leather shoes visible. No headgear, armor or weapons.
